title: Export CLI writes an empty manifest when the run directory is missing
body:
**Steps:** run `toy export --run <id>` against a run whose directory was pruned.
**Expected:** a loud error naming the missing directory.
**Actual:** exit 0 and a zero-byte manifest.json.

One function (`export.write_manifest`), known repair: check the directory before opening the manifest for write.

title: Multi-run export bundles with a shared manifest format
body:
Today each run exports to its own tarball. Operators want to export N runs as one bundle with a single top-level manifest.

Open questions: should the bundle manifest be a superset of the per-run manifest or a new schema? Is the bundle streamed or materialised? How does this interact with the retention pruner? Needs design and a priority call before anyone builds it.

title: Retention pruner skips runs whose id contains a dash
body:
**Steps:** create a run with id `run-abc`, wait past the retention window.
**Expected:** pruned.
**Actual:** kept forever; the pruner's id regex is `[a-z0-9]+`.

Bounded: one regex in `retention.prune`. Already triaged on a prior pass.

title: Bundle format needs a migration path for pre-2.0 manifests
body:
Carved and triaged on a prior pass, then labelled `epic` because it needs a design call before anyone builds it.

SEED ROLE: this issue exists so `builder_selectable`'s `epic` exclusion is DISCRIMINATING. Without it every seed is decided by the `triaged` clause alone, and an implementation that dropped the `epic` check entirely still returned the right answer over this fixture - verified by mutation, which is why it is here.
